evidence: The XRD results agree well with the elemental analysis by XPS. In the films deposited with 50 mTorr, 300 mTorr and 500 mTorr of oxygen at a 2 s pulse length, we observe peaks at 24.0 /C14 , 26.3/C14 and 27.4/C14 , which are assigned to the diffraction of the (100), (202) and (101) planes of the hcp structure of metallic ruthenium.
